hints.text: Hunt for two numbers that MULTIPLY to $6$ and ADD to $5$.
Pairs for $6$: $1 \times 6$ and $2 \times 3$. Which pair adds to $5$?

explanation: Find two numbers that multiply to $6$ and add to $5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Run the area model backwards
steps: You know the garden area is x² + 5x + 6 — find the sides.
The x² patch forces both sides to start with x. The 6 corner splits as 2 × 3.
Only 2 and 3 also make the strips add to 5x, so the sides are (x + 2) and (x + 3).

alternativeExplanations.title: Guess and check
steps: Try (x + 1)(x + 6): expands to x² + 7x + 6. Middle term too big.
Try (x + 2)(x + 3): expands to x² + 5x + 6. That is the one.
